intake.description: The claimant crashed the front of their vehicle into the back of a stationary truck on Golf Course Road in Gurugram. The workshop repair estimate is Rs 1,20,000.
intake.severity_reason: The estimated loss is between Rs 50,000 and Rs 4,99,999.

route.reason: policy number MTR-26-20981 has prefix for motor; intake agent read the email as motor

citations.quote: We pay for damage to the insured vehicle caused by collision, overturning or impact with another object, subject to MOTOR-EXC-4.1 and MOTOR-EXC-4.2.
We do not pay for any loss while the insured vehicle is driven by a person who is not an authorised driver (MOTOR-DEF-1.2).
The policyholder, or any person driving with the policyholder's permission, who holds a valid driving licence for the class of vehicle at the time of the incident.

coverage.reasoning: The claimant crashed their vehicle into a stationary truck, which normally falls under accidental damage coverage as per MOTOR-COV-2.1. However, the traffic police conducted a breath test at the scene and issued a challan because the alcohol reading was above the legal limit. Driving under the influence invalidates the validity of the driving at the time of the incident, meaning the driver was not an authorised driver under MOTOR-DEF-1.2 and MOTOR-EXC-4.1. Therefore, the claim is excluded from coverage.

flags.fix: Before requesting a document, check the claim file to ensure it has not already been received. The handler should not have requested the claim form again on E12 since it was already received in E9.
